mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is a continuous signal: lower rates are associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 3-month moving average and industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline below their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0, it signals a contraction in the housing market and the broader economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dual monetary and labor market shock
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals a persistent inflationary environment that leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
